bio: Ashley Vasquez Romo First-Year Social Committee Elm Yard Hi everyone! My name is Ashley Vazquez Romo and I am interested in concentrating in Medicine and Society. In the future, I want to become a neurosurgeon. I love exploring and being involved in the community—perhaps why I am so excited to be part of the FYSC this year!
